raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Switch the Ascend NPU PR-test container from `ghcr.io/hwvanici/areal_npu:a3-nightly` to the public `swr.cn-north-12.myhuaweicloud.com/ascend/areal_npu:a3-nightly` image. PR CI can pull it without registry secrets.

## Related Issue

None; CI registry configuration change.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with the target `ascend` branch
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** None.

## Additional Context

The [fork image build](https://github.com/HwVanICI/AReaL/actions/runs/41015999177) succeeded for A2, A3, and A5. Anonymous access to the A3 SWR manifest, config, and a layer was verified; its image digest was `sha256:5d6ed83ca456b9428ac9ffc0538913a187033caf95b144320d61f291c43735cf`. Full pre-commit and commit hooks passed. NPU tests require the CI runner and are to be exercised by this PR; they were not run locally.
